subject: System Design
title: Embedded Databases
description: Learn Embedded Databases in one minute.

hook.text: SQLite runs on every iPhone, every Android phone, and every web browser. It's the most deployed database ever.

buildup.text: An embedded database runs inside your application process. No separate server, no network calls.

discovery.text: SQLite stores an entire database in a single file. It's used in apps, browsers, and even aircraft systems.

twist.text: Embedded databases don't handle concurrent writes from multiple processes. They're single-writer by design.

climax.text: Not every database needs a server. For local storage, embedded databases are simpler, faster, and more reliable.

punchline.text: The most used database runs inside your phone.

quiz.question: What is an embedded database?
options: A database that runs inside the application process without a separate server
A database stored in the cloud
A database only for mobile apps
